name: Kalmykia (Kalmyk SSR, 1990–1992)
description: A red field with a blue vertical stripe at the hoist, a yellow hammer and sickle beneath a yellow-bordered red star in the upper hoist, and the inscription 'Калмыцкая ССР / Хальмг ССР' in Russian and Kalmyk in yellow.
history: The RSFSR-pattern flag of the Kalmyk ASSR with the inscription changed after the republic became the Kalmyk SSR in October 1990. It was replaced in 1992 by a light blue, yellow and red tricolour with a lotus.

features.role: inscription 'Калмыцкая ССР / Хальмг ССР' in Russian and Kalmyk
